name: Traverse City
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Traverse City?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Traverse City, a registered low-speed vehicle may use streets posted 35 mph or less and may cross a faster street. No city resolution allowing plain golf carts was found.

lsv.notes: Registered and insured; a state highway can still be closed

rules.rule: A registered low-speed vehicle may use a street posted 35 mph or less, and may cross a faster street.
A city may allow golf carts only by resolution. No Traverse City or Holland resolution was found.

banned_roads.name: State trunk lines posted over 35 mph

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Traverse City?
faq.a: Streets posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured; a state highway can still be closed. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Traverse City?
faq.a: No. Michigan allows that only after the city adopts a resolution, and none was found.

faq.q: What streets can an LSV use in Traverse City?
faq.a: Streets posted 35 mph or less. A faster street can be crossed, not driven along.
